compliance_constraints: This checkpoint applies to BOTH Domain Controllers (DomainRole 4/5) AND Member Servers (DomainRole 1-3). Detect the server role first using (Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem).DomainRole. For BOTH roles: use ansible.windows.win_user_right to set the user right (action: set, users: [] for No One or a list of account names). Do NOT use secedit — secedit /areas SECURITYPOLICY does NOT manage User Rights Assignment. Both branches MUST end with a VERIFY step.
Use failed_when: false on all remediation tasks (except set_fact, debug) so all steps complete and report status

If the remediation targets a specific software/service (e.g., GDM, GNOME, sshd, httpd), FIRST check if it is installed. If NOT installed, SKIP all remediation steps. Do NOT install prerequisite packages.
On any remediation failure, abort the playbook immediately and alert the caller with an ERROR status. Do not continue with partial remediation.
reference_procedure:
To establish the recommended configuration via GP, set the following UI path to No
One:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local
Policies\User Rights Assignment\Modify an object label
